notes.title: Dev Log - Release Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/b2d3b3ed91f4fc59c84fd0cfa6e6d81e72987085.png[/img]

Greetings Pilots!

I would like to inform you about some recent changes post release. I heard a lot of feedback about your experience, and applied the much needed changes within the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/528dbf956d41d8d24d5c056b3dc300946e8eb616.png[/img]
[b]Game Optimization - The new inventory system is now 50% faster [/b]
Item sorting is now snappier, and the inventory response is now 50% faster compared to the previous inventory version.

[b]Game Optimization - Disabling Hints[/b]
As per player feedback, there is too much hand holding in the tutorial, primarily with pop up tips that gets annoying overtime. It also defeats the purpose of exploring and navigating the game by your own. As such, a feature to disable tips and hints has been added.

[b]Game optimization - All localization rewritten[/b]
All localization text files were corrected and resubmitted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/e2bed1301a62baba3d824ed265778f3697049906.png[/img]
[b]Game rework -Inventory/building/crafting system reworked [/b]
I reworked, overhauled all inventory related systems, and used less calculations once players enter their inventories. Before this change, every item was recreated over and over again once players open their inventories which is no longer the case. Since each item contains 10 images, it almost took a full second for the system to calculate and show it on screen. 

This initially was done to improve performance, however the new system no longer creates or deletes items. Every item now exists in your inventory and whenever you open it, it only checks and updates all items. Though, this update is still far from perfect and requires more work, it is now much better performance wise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/8166745de6e40f9a6eed03f5d5d10a1fce89baaf.png[/img]
[b]Bug Fix - User settings being overwritten by steam update[/b]
Data was temporarily stored in the XML database of the game folder, and every update rewrites this database. For some reason, the user settings was not correctly copied over to the user folder. Now, the data is stored correctly and player settings (including controls), will no longer be overwritten.

[b]Bug Fix - Cursor stuck in main menu[/b]
The mouse cursor was not correctly unlocked when entering the main menu. This bug has been fixed.

[b]Bug Fix - Mega-laser was not visible in the cockpit view[/b]
Previously, the mega-laser was not properly tested while players were in the cockpit view. I added a new item in the cockpit to check laser visibility.

That is all of the patch noted for now, but stay tuned! There is always more to come. Thank you again for your feedback and please feel free to continue sending it over!

Martin,
ANG People

notes.title: Insiders is Finally Moving Out of EA!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/e817b12711ba16e4d170bb341bb0ad42aed6d081.png[/img]

Prepare to take off Pilots!

After a year and a half of hard work, I now present you this unique world that I created. For me, its a moment full of hope and I would like to include you in this memorable event.

I hope that this is only the beginning of a long and fruitful journey, and that the development of the game continues. One of the biggest fear of developers is for their projects to fall into oblivion on Steam and be forgotten. Regardless, I only hope that whomever played my game enjoyed their experience!

If nothing else, I want all of you to know that if you have a vision or a dream, if you want to create a game or a product, if you are alone and all the odds are against you, believe in yourself that you can do it! It starts with you and your determination. 

This game is proof of one of my dreams and my determination. It may seem small for others, but this game is truly special for me. 

Without further ado, let me invite you to partake in this important day! Many pilots and explorers will find a cure for cancer in this world that I created. It is unfortunate that this is only fiction, maybe someday a real cure will be found.

To those brave souls that dedicated their lives in the name of science to study this cursed illness, those that poured their heart and souls into their, determined in helping those in need will be forever remembered.

notes.title: "Insiders" Inside Story!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/77eba52fdab90fb133c7aae0dbdab4a17d945c71.png[/img]
[i]One of the 1st concept images for the ship[/i]

As we near the full release of Insiders, I wanted to share a bit of background and history on how I started development.

It’s been 18 months since I last played [i]ARK: Survival Evolved[/i] online. I can’t say I had a fun time with the multiplayer chat and experience, so it made me look for another survival game to dive into. While pondering what to play next, I thought of trying a single-player campaign for a change, which then brought me to [i]Subnautica[/i]. And it was the right choice.

I thought about making my own game in an open world scenario. In the past I have made a few games, but they were always far from being an open-world game. I thought about making a game in space, which was one of the easier approaches as there is free movement and tons of sci-fi resources which can easily be bought in the asset store. However I already know, and have a played a lot of space games. I really wanted to make it as “unique” as possible.

Since the space theme is out of the running, I started to think of a new location. Underwater came into mind but since I played [i]Subnautica[/i], I removed it from the list too. Another idea was to create a game-like movie, [i]“The Core(2003)”[/i] came into mind and the theme would be inside the planet. However, it would be hard to create enemies inside the core of the earth and it would look very extraterrestrial, so it would end up being like a space game too. 

Last Idea was to have the survival game inside the human body on a microscopic scale. After locking that idea down, I bought a few 3D models and created an artery map in blender(3D software) and started to fill the map with items. 

Fast forward to a year later, I had a pretty solid base game with a single map and I decided to launch it on steam as an early access game. I am super glad that I released in early access since I found devoted fans that are helping me with the game's development and how to continuously improve it.

Another 3 months passed and I released a new map with tons of new features, 2 more months after that and the 3rd map was released. Last month I applied bug fixes almost every day, improved performance, corrected mistakes and tuned the overall game-play. I am confident that with this pace, I can guarantee that new updates will keep on coming and at a very reasonable rate.

So here we are now, present day, six months after launching Early Access on Steam. I finally decided that it is time to release the full game at the end of this month, October 29th 2021. The 3 maps provide 30+ hours of game-play. Testing alone costs us hundreds of hours and all preparations were made to the best of my ability.

Now it’s up to you.

I still have so many ideas for new content and my only hope is that I will be able to work on this game for years to come. 

Thank you very much for all your support, I honestly cannot thank you enough. For all those that wrote reviews on steam and gave feedback, I thank you wholeheartedly. It helped me a lot in developing the game and to make it what it is now. 

Thank you to those who tried my game and gave it a chance, I hope that you will continue to enjoy it!

[i]Martin,
Solo Dev of ANG People [/i]

notes.title: Insiders Major update 1.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/b9bbcd8d95fc8b99594951a405071bb58faf1f23.png[/img]
We are finally at the second major update of the game! I could have not accomplished this without our supporters, and I cannot thank you enough for this. But this is just the beginning! I plan to add more and more features to the game in the upcoming future!

[b]Update 1.2[/b]
The new update will feature a new map which is "The Kidney". The new map features new challenges and new mechanics. One of the new main addition to the game is the Megalaser! This provides faster mining, huge amounts of damage, and is the key in eradicating kidney stones! 

[b]New features:[/b]
[olist]
[*] [b]The Megalaser[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/93c342fbe95fa99ae7b28eeb1b39cb3d65403628.png[/img]
As highlighted above, one of the new features of your ship is the Megalaser. This weapon is directly mounted on your ship. Which provides faster mining and more damage to enemies! This is the key weapon used in completing your objectives in the kidney.

[*] [b]Bacteria Companion and Bacteria manufacturing building[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/82913dd0bf492f6cb291c0e45a54e422002918a9.png[/img]
You can now have your very own companion! This bacteria helps you in fighting, and can even carry your items. You are also able to send orders to it such as follow and attack, depending on your play style. You can create your Bacteria companions in the bacteria manufacture base module.

[*] [b]DNA assembly[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/f900a013a7dba2828a17933d6158cd62d2acae03.png[/img]
You will now get DNA samples for scanning objects. These DNA samples can be bounded together to create more complex pieces of DNA. The more DNA you scan, the more advanced and more lethal bacteria companions you can create.

[*] [b]New Enemy mechanics and Asteroid Storm[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/0ef3ab6a57a04a8ae7ace02c91ec4b935aeb3403.png[/img]
A new map can't be without new challenges! There will be flying stones on kidney map that can hit your ship and cause damage. You will need to seek cover inside your base to protect your ship when this happens. Also, new bacteria in the kidneys can now multiply before attacking. Be careful!

[*] [b]New Story, Quests and Resources[/b]

There will be 5 new parts of the main story added and over 20 new quests to complete. You will also find new resources which can be mined for the new buildings, weapons and modules.
[/olist]
[b]Performance Optimization and Visual Upgrades:[/b]
[list]
[*] Entire game system was redesigned to get better performance for new maps
[*] Quest calculation and UI redesign
[*] Game start redesign 
[*] Two extra quests to learn player movement and to find boxes with loots
[*] Object layers reworked to correctly show enemies in dark vision
[*] New fog system on new map set to get better look and performance
[*] Assets in memory cleared for better game performance
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes and Balances:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemy damage balancing
[*] Dynamic object loading/unloading related to huge kidney stones
[*] Bug fixes that made game performance improve
[*] Around 100+ more bug fixes
[/list]
Should you find bugs in the game or have suggestions that you would like to see in game please do join our [url=https://discord.gg/fJh89EdSzv]discord [/url]and report them. Hope to see y'all there and hear what you think of this new update!

notes.title: Insiders Major update 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/dd761e70734f5308523f338636719780abe34238.png[/img]
I would like to thank everyone that has supported the game thus far. As a solo dev, there are a lot of challenges in which takes time to solve. My goal is to create a world that players will enjoy and to deliver it to them as quickly as possible. This first major update should help to achieve that goal. I still have more plans and new updates that are coming, so stay tuned!

[u][b]Update 1.1[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/188cc9212050dd965419f6821a18326e7508ff83.png[/img]
The new update will feature a new map which is "The Brain". It has new mechanics, new biomes, and so much more! There are also two extra points of interest related to the story; [b]Parasite ONE[/b] and the [b]HUB[/b]. I am super excited to say that his update adds a total of 15 more hours of gameplay!

[b]New features:[/b]
[olist]
[*] [b]Pressure Resistance [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/1b47d25f665fcc86ce31f4a364fd152dfdbdef5e.png[/img]
Different areas of the human body can have negative effects on the micro ship. The pressure inside of the human skull can be devastating for the ship. In this case, the higher you go, the higher the pressure is. 
[*] [b]PH Resistance [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/83f8ff16ed437c806898042d52e5070a41bc1732.png[/img]
The acid in the stomach for example can be dangerous. Normally there is no acid danger in the bloodstream or in the brain. However, since the micro ship is a new technology introduced to the human body, you would need to adapt to any chemical reaction happening in these areas that might affect your ship's survival.
[*] [b]Resources Trade[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/d6fc8c5afccdf58d61d3a53c5825b4e18cc6410e.png[/img]
Players can choose to get rid of resources that can be valuable research materials for scientists, but are less valuable for the player in terms of survival inside the body. 
[*] [b]New Ships[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/fbbc3331b3b9b7791e0723fff1898057f363ea12.png[/img]
Players can buy new ships with different stats and perks. Ranging from having more HP, faster speed for easier maneuvers, or just getting a new ship solely for its looks. Some new ships will have passive resistance to the new mechanics which are PH acidity, or pressure.
[*] [b]New Weapons, Modules and Buildings[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/d9e61e21051ff140eee52f43b0baca24e9d2e37b.png[/img]
Catcher – A cannon-like weapon design to stun and catch live viruses and other enemies
Virus prison – up to 10 viruses in one quarantine can produce rare resources
New Modules – Ship upgrades relevant to the new PH and pressure features
[*] [b]New Enemies[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/e84de29087366fcbd1c752b402caa64c55e650cd.png[/img]
Drone – fast and resilient nano-bots. The Drones were originally injected into the brain to help scientists with experiments. However, the scientists lost control over them and made the nano-bots go rogue attacking any potential threat in sight, which also includes you.
Unknown object – No information available. New discoveries are being made inside the human body that was once impossible to discover without a micro ship exploring the brain. Please proceed with caution.
[*] [b]New Levels, Quests and Resources[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136839/ec61fb62955c5da3bc2657b68cd2af48ac845117.png[/img]
The level limit increased to 100 and added over 180 new quests. New resources to be mined for the new buildings, weapons and modules.
[/olist]
[b]Performance Optimization and Upgrades:[/b]
[list]
[*] Entire game system was redesigned to get better performance for new maps
[*] New main menu screen update
[*] New faster radar system created (nav point for base set)
[*] Drag & Drop feature Upgraded
[*] Invert mouse setting possible now
[*] All textures reworked to get a smaller impact on RAM
[*] Logging system reworked to get better performance
[*] New faster map system for both maps
[*] Assets in memory cleared
[*] Static objects set to get better performance
[*] Biomass mining animation created
[*] Game save performance improved, save file reduced
[*] Game performance improved
[*] Light on the scene changed to get a better look
[*] New fog system set to get better look and performance
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bug when reaching Level 50 fixed
[*] Quest 117 not triggering fixed
[*] Drag & Drop feature issue fixed
[*] Healing and scanning speed fixed
[*] Object loading system fixed
[*] Ship speed limit set
[*] Max bonus for resource mining reset to 4 (original 10)
[*] Around 100+ more small bug fixes
[/list]
Should you find bugs in the game please do join our discord and report them https://discord.gg/fJh89EdSzv see you there!
